about: Public description of trainer-host-v835-64k (NOT a ROOT-signed admission). Derived from live host-v834c/v834d. Async ZeRO-2 reduce-to-owner in post-accumulate hooks, shard clip before gather, pinned-CPU gather into the host optimizer, thresholded activation offload for >=64K packed bins.
model_class: transformers 5.14.1 Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration (hybrid GDN + full attention, vocab 248320)
trainable: model.language_model.* and lm_head.* (vision tower and MTP heads frozen)

memory_fix.v834c_problem: full actor replica + eager FP32 accumulator (~36 GB) + BF16 param grads (~18 GB) per GPU
memory_fix.v835_change: async GPU reduce-SUM to owner in post-accumulate hooks (no CPU contrib, no post-bwd reduce_shards); clip on shards; gather to pinned CPU on rank 0; activation offload only when packed bin tokens >= 65536
memory_fix.expected_peak_64k_gib: ~65 GiB measured (async path); ~48 GiB with offload

qualification.note: Unsigned experimental host. Do not deploy live until 8xH200 qual JSON is green and ROOT re-admits a signed bundle.
